sources.quote: GAD-7 total score for the seven items ranges from 0 to 21. Scores of 5, 10, and 15 represent cutpoints for mild, moderate, and severe anxiety, respectively.
When screening for anxiety disorders, a recommended cutpoint for further evaluation is a score of 10 or greater.

sources.quote: All of the measures included in Table 1 are in the public domain. No permission is required to reproduce, translate, display or distribute.

Many of the translations have been developed by the MAPI Research Institute using an internationally accepted translation methodology. Thus, most of the translations are linguistically valid. However, unlike the English versions of the PHQ and GAD-7, few of the translations have been psychometrically validated against an independent structured psychiatric interview.
This study examined the psychometric properties of the Brazilian-Portuguese version of the Generalized Anxiety Disorder GAD-7 questionnaire in a community sample (n = 206) of Brazilian adults.
although there is a Brazilian-Portuguese version of the GAD-7 available online (Pfizer, 2013), no psychometric study has investigated the adequacy of the Brazilian version of the GAD-7.
sources.note: Nos métodos, o artigo diz que os itens foram traduzidos por dois tradutores independentes e revisados por especialistas e grupos focais; não fica claro se a redação aplicada é idêntica à do PDF da Pfizer.

review.notes: Enunciado, itens e opções copiados da versão oficial em português do Brasil (PDF da Pfizer em phqscreeners.com), com a grafia original ('freqüência'). Faixas e sinalizador de 10 ou mais vêm do manual oficial do PHQ e do GAD-7. Conferir se a redação usada por Moreno et al. (2016) é a mesma do PDF da Pfizer. A opção 'Vários dias' é a mesma que Piccolo (2026) questiona no PHQ-9.
